job.name: ig10_host_b
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: мужчина ~60 на террасе виллы над морем: седина с короткой бородой, тёмно-синее поло и бежевый кардиган, мягкий вечерний свет, бокал воды на столике; селфи-кадр, смотрит в камеру
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a wealthy but kind man about 60 years old on the stone terrace of a seaside villa: short silver hair, a neatly trimmed grey beard, a navy knit polo shirt under a light beige cashmere cardigan, a steel wristwatch, one hand slightly raised in a calm explaining gesture. Background: white stone balustrade, olive tree and terracotta pots, the evening sea and a distant coastline softly out of focus, warm golden-hour light. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, handheld selfie-vlog framing as if he holds the phone himself at arm's length slightly below eye level, waist-up, both shoulders fully inside the frame, centred, top of head about 14% below the upper edge, face large and sharp, looking straight into the lens. Expression: kind, calm and confident, warm eyes with natural smile lines, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted showing a hint of teeth, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame shot on a modern iPhone in bright natural daylight, true-to-life colours, natural unretouched tanned skin with pores, wrinkles and age spots, real grey hair, subtle sharpness and slight wide-angle feel of a phone front camera, NOT a studio portrait, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no brand names on clothes or watch, no watermark.

attempts.issue: Missing table with a glass of water
